headlines.description: Brett Hull moved into third place on the NHL career goal list by scoring 1:51 into overtime Monday night of the Detroit Red Wings' 3-2 victory over the Los Angeles Kings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Landmark Hull goal gives Wings OT win
